signs.aries: You say it before you have finished thinking it, argue to find out what you believe, and learn best by having a go.
signs.taurus: You speak slowly and mean it, take your time absorbing anything new, and are almost impossible to argue out of a settled view.
signs.gemini: Talking is how you think; you keep several conversations running, read constantly, and are the sibling or neighbour everybody hears from.
signs.cancer: You communicate in tone more than in content, remember exactly how things were said, and are closely bound to your siblings or your street.
signs.leo: Your voice carries and you use it; you make an entrance in a conversation, and you were either the class star or the class clown.
signs.virgo: You proofread everything including conversations, keep meticulous notes, and were the pupil who had actually done the reading.
signs.libra: You phrase everything diplomatically, see both sides before you have chosen one, and argue the missing position almost involuntarily.
signs.scorpio: You research rather than chat, and a sibling or a school year holds something your family still does not discuss.
signs.sagittarius: You speak in broad strokes and get caught on the detail, say what you think unedited, and learn by going somewhere and seeing.
signs.capricorn: Your schooling was hard going or cut short, you write better than you speak, and whatever you do learn stays learned.
signs.aquarius: You learned in a way that did not suit the school you were put in, and your siblings and neighbours are an odd assortment.
signs.pisces: Facts blur for you but atmosphere never does, and you pick up what a sibling or a neighbour is carefully not saying.
